## History

During the village hall project, a paint order mix-up resulted in the building being painted a glaring blue instead of green. As news of the mistake spread, the rest of the villagers rallied behind the local youth while laying the blame for the error on the Pye family.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040)_

## Relationships

### [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/john-andrew--roger-pye.md)

Roger Pye is the parent of [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md). Their family name becomes a point of contention in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) when the villagers blame the Pye family for a mix-up that results in the new village hall being painted blue instead of green.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), +2 more_
